item.title: New Optional Items & Limited-time Sale!
item.description: New optional items will be added to the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store staring Friday, May 29 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). We’re also hosting a limited-time sale on a selection of costumes and mounts, so don’t miss out! Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store. * The items featured above will be available for purchase after the scheduled maintenance ends on Friday, May 29 around 1:00 a.m. (PDT). Please visit the News section for detailed maintenance information. * During periods immediately following the sale of new optional items, congestion in the delivery system may cause item deliveries to take longer than usual.

For this episode, we'll be recapping the announcements from Fan Festival 2026 in Anaheim before delving into the latest Patch 7.5 content, so put on your best glamour and join us for some screenshots at the Tuliyollal Aetheryte Plaza on Ragnarok (Chaos DC)!

item.title: The Make It Rain Campaign Begins May 29!
item.description: The Make It Rain Campaign returns once more to the Gold Saucer! With a 50% MGP bonus and an assortment of adorable otter-themed goods on offer, you won't want to miss out! Furthermore, campaign attendants will be offering a range of items at discounted prices, including some exclusive limited-time deals, so be sure to join the festivities and rake in the rewards while you can! Read on for details.

item.title: Crystalline Conflict Regional Championship 2026 (Europe & Oceania) Quarterfinals Streaming Details & Brackets

Tune in to the upcoming tournament live stream on the official FINAL FANTASY XIV Twitch channel, where teams will be battling it out to secure a place in the Semifinals at Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin. Click here for more details.

item.title: FANTASIAN Neo Dimension Collaboration Optional Items - Leaving Soon!
item.description: The optional items created in collaboration with FANTASIAN Neo Dimension—an original RPG from the father of FINAL FANTASY, Hironobu Sakaguchi, and renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu—will be leaving the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store on Monday, June 1, 2026 around 12:00 a.m. (PDT). If you've been meaning to get them, don't miss out! Visit the FINAL FANTASY XIV Online Store. * Collaboration items may return in the future after the sale period has concluded.

item.title: Play Free for up to 4 Days in the Latest Free Login Campaign!
item.description: In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

item.title: Sugar, Spice, Would Pumpkin Suffice?

Lali-ho, it's Kiwikopo from the Community team! o/
Autumn is here, which means that the season for all things pumpkin is upon us once more. (Who wouldn't FALL for a good slice of pumpkin pie?!) And what better way to celebrate this hauntingly delightful occasion with the return of All Saints' Wake!

item.title: FFXIV x Monster Hunter Wilds Screenshot Campaign!
item.description:
Greetings everyone, it's Voltenyne from the Community team!
Patch 7.35 introduces the exciting new FFXIV x Monster Hunter Wilds crossover, so we are holding a screenshot campaign to celebrate!

item.title: Celebrate the 12th Anniversary with the Rising!
item.description:
Greetings, everyone!
Zhexos here, trying to cool down in this summer heat. I wish I was on a cruise ship, chilling in a cold pool with my fellow Warrior of Light buddies, maybe doing some jumping activities, and sliding down a water slide. That is exactly what you can do at this year's Moonfire Faire event that is currently underway until Tuesday, August 26, 2025 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT).

item.title: What Time Is It? It's Moonfire Faire Time!
item.description:
Hello! This is Chesskyth from the Community team.
Summer is in full swing, and you might find yourself wishing to enjoy the beautiful weather and vibes without dealing with the heat. What better combo fits the bill than an Eorzean summer vacation and an AC unit (or fan)?

item.title: Lali-ho, we went to Anime Expo!
item.description:
Hello, everyone!  
It's Ali from the FFXIV Marketing team back with another event recap! We had an amazing opportunity to come to Anime Expo this year and celebrate with Yoshi-P who was invited as a Guest of Honor! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Minaryne from the Community team who has a lovely recap of the Cosplay Gathering at Anime Expo and our Downtown Los Angeles Gathering!

item.title: Unleashed
item.description:
Voltenyne here, with the final round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
We've finally arrived at the theme of Howling Blade! It's hard to focus on the song when you're evading his dashes and beams, so let's disengage from the fight and lock in on those lyrics!

item.title: Not Afraid
item.description:
Here's Voltenyne, coming in from the top ropes to deliver a third round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
Time for us to go balls-to-the-wall and smash through the floor with Brute Abominator's theme! His rage has grown out of control and won't stop until he's blown away the competition!

item.title: Back to the Drawing Board
item.description:
Hey everyone, Voltenyne here!
Hope you all wore a smock, because we'll be dipping into the colorful lyrics of Sugar Riot's theme!

item.title: Ride the Rhythm
item.description:
Hey fellow Arcadion challengers, it's Voltenyne!
I'm here to reveal the lyrics from the Arcadion's Cruiserweight Tier!
